text: Yeah, actually, there is. I think I have another order pending here, but I'm not sure of the number. It was like five items, but I don't remember the ID. I was going to cancel it because I don't need those items anymore. Could you help me with that?
zh: 嗯，实际上，有。我想我还有一个待处理的订单，但我不确定编号。大概有五件商品，但我记不住ID了。我本来打算取消它，因为我不再需要这些商品了。您能帮我处理一下吗？
